note.zh: 15 的两个选项各开始一个情境：研究（→ 水晶裂隙，可继续探索）或摧毁（→ 球体碎成材料）。两个情境都需要科技“裂隙探球”才有进度；若期间失去水晶球所在的星系（astral_planes.20 设置 has_lost_crystal_sphere），情境中止。
note.en: The two options of 15 each start a situation: study (→ the Crystal Rift, which can then be explored) or destroy (→ the sphere is shattered into materials). Both situations make no progress without the Rift Sphere technology; losing the sphere's system (astral_planes.20 sets has_lost_crystal_sphere) aborts them.

astral_planes.30.zh: 奇怪的球体（尚无探球科技）
astral_planes.30.en: A Strange Sphere (no Rift Sphere yet)

texts.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的裂隙探球技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
texts.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the Rift Sphere technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

texts.zh:
鉴于我们最近对星界裂隙的研究，我们发现位于[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]的晶态球状物体与我们开发的裂隙探球技术有很多相似之处。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有关维度旅行的珍贵线索。
texts.en:
In light of our recent research into Astral Rifts, we have discovered that the crystalline spherical object in [crystal_sphere_system.GetName] bares many similarities to the Rift Sphere technology we have developed.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

texts.zh:
一个奇怪的物体已经到达[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道上。

这个晶态球形物体让人想起我们自己的裂隙探球技术，它突然出现在没有任何已知轨迹的地方。

由于与[Root.Capital.GetName]如此接近，这个球体可能对我们的人民构成重大威胁。

另一方面，它很有可能包含有关维度旅行性质的珍贵线索。
texts.en:
A strange object has arrived in orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName].

A crystalline sphere reminiscent of our own Rift Sphere technology, it appeared without warning along no known trajectory.

At such close proximity to [Root.Capital.GetName], the sphere may represent a significant danger to our people.

On the other hand, it is also highly likely to contain valuable insights into the nature of dimensional travel.

notes.zh: 球体只送一次（全局标记 crystal_sphere_sent）。每年脉冲检查 astral_planes.10：游戏已过中期 1 年以上、至少一个国家完成 5 次裂隙探索；然后在已有“裂隙探球”且完成 ≥3 次探索的国家中，按每国的随机骰（裂隙世界起源减半，AI 加倍）与探索次数、游戏年数比较，取完成探索最多者；球体生成在其最靠近首都的、没有天然虫洞的己方星系（游牧帝国则在己方航站所在星系），10 天 + 随机 350 天后触发 15。
notes.en: The sphere is sent only once (global flag crystal_sphere_sent). The yearly pulse checks astral_planes.10: more than a year of mid-game has passed and at least one country has completed 5 rift explorations; among countries with the Rift Sphere technology and ≥3 completed explorations, a per-country random roll (halved for Riftworld, doubled for AI) is compared with the exploration count and game years, and the country with the most explorations is chosen; the sphere appears in its owned system closest to the capital without a natural wormhole (nomads: the system of an owned waystation), and 15 fires 10 days plus up to 350 random days later.

texts.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
texts.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

sections.zh: 这个设备似乎正在以某种仔细考量的方式慢慢调整自己。我们相信，随着时间的推移，它将完成它被设计去执行的任务。
sections.en: The device seems to be aligning itself slowly in a deliberate fashion. We believe that, over time, it will accomplish what it was designed to do.

sections.zh: 如果我们能够投入足够的科学研究来开发这个设备的潜力，我们相信可以加速其激活。
sections.en: If we were to dedicate enough scientific research to unlocking the potential of this device, we believe we can accelerate its activation.

sections.zh: 星界丝缕似乎可以对这个装置进行刺激。我们刺激得越多，它激活得就越快。
sections.en: Astral thread seems to stimulate the device. The more we expose it to, the faster its activation.

sections.zh: 我们没有获得必要的裂隙探球科技去正确地开展我们的研究。
sections.en: We do not possess the Rift Sphere technology necessary to correctly carry on with our research.

texts.zh:
这是一条消息。

刻录在晶体内部的某个不可能存在的网络中，有一组指令。

我们严格按照指令去做，成功地再造了蚀刻在晶体球周围所暗示的条件。一种精确的气体和星界丝缕的排列已经起到了“激活”这个球体的作用。

随后，它突然消失了。取而代之的是一个我们从未见过的星界裂隙凝聚而成的景象。

它的存在邀请我们去探索。
texts.en:
It is a message.

Encoded within an impossible network of crystal, there were a set of instructions.

Followed to the letter, we were able to recreate the conditions inscribed around the crystal sphere. A precise arrangement of gases and astral thread have worked to 'activate' the sphere.

Shortly afterwards, it simply disappeared. In its place, an Astral Rift unlike anything we have ever seen coalesced into view.

Its existence invites exploration.

label.zh: 球体消失，原地出现“晶体裂隙”
label.en: The sphere vanishes and the Crystal Rift appears in its place

label.zh: 研究结束：晶体裂隙出现
label.en: The Study Is Over: the Crystal Rift appears

note.zh: 按球体上的指示布置气体与星界丝缕后，球体消失，在水晶球星系生成晶体裂隙（见《晶体裂隙》）。
note.en: After arranging gases and astral threads as the sphere's instructions say, the sphere vanishes and the Crystal Rift appears in the crystal sphere system (see “The Crystal Rift”).

texts.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
texts.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

sections.zh: 我们没有获得必要的裂隙探球科技去正确地开展我们的研究。
sections.en: We do not possess the Rift Sphere technology necessary to correctly carry on with our research.

texts.zh:
结束了。

水晶球体已经被打碎成无数闪闪发光的碎屑。

我们立即回收了数量丰富的珍贵材料。它的基本元素与我们以往所遇到的任何东西都不同。

我们的人民正在庆祝这一保护我们家园安全的激进决定。让这样的装置留在我们的边境上是不负责任的。
texts.en:
It is done.

The Crystalline Sphere has been shattered into innumerable glittering grains.

We immediately harvested the bounty of valuable material. Its base elements are unlike anything we have ever encountered before.

Our people are celebrating the bold decision to maintain the safety and security of our home. Allowing such a device to remain within our borders would have been irresponsible.

note.zh: 获得 100 星界丝缕、500 稀有水晶与 500 奇异气体、修正 destroy_sphere_modifier（3600 天）和标本“水晶球体碎片”；排外或狂暴灭绝者另得凝聚力。球体被毁，此后不再有晶体裂隙。
note.en: 100 astral threads, 500 rare crystals and 500 exotic gases, modifier destroy_sphere_modifier (3600 days) and the specimen “crystal sphere fragments”; xenophobes and homicidal empires also get unity. The sphere is gone and there will be no Crystal Rift.

texts.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

我们对它的目的和来源不甚知晓。或许，借由未来研究的进展，我们能够找到如何使用它的线索。
texts.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

We are unsure of its purpose or origin. Perhaps with some future research we can gain insight on how to approach it.

label.zh: 我们会时刻注意观察它。
label.en: We'll keep an eye on it.

label.zh: 之后研究出“裂隙探球”时
label.en: Once the Rift Sphere technology is researched later

summary.text:
# 水晶球体 / The Crystal Sphere

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`events/astral_planes_events.txt:744–1065`；`events/astral_planes_situation_events.txt:1–76`；`common/situations/06_astral_planes_situations.txt:150–355`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（全篇 whole story；原先的触发器故事 10、25、35 已并入 / the former trigger stories merged in）

## 如何开始 How it starts

每年脉冲检查 `astral_planes.10`（`on_yearly_pulse`，`00_on_actions.txt:257`）：游戏进入中期一年以上，且至少一个国家完成了 5 次裂隙探索时，从已有“裂隙探球”并完成 ≥3 次探索的国家里挑选完成探索最多者（每国有随机骰：裂隙世界起源减半，AI 加倍），把一个水晶球体送到它最靠近首都、没有天然虫洞的星系（游牧帝国：己方航站所在星系）。全局标记 `crystal_sphere_sent` 保证只送一次。10 天 + 最多 350 天后触发 `astral_planes.15`。

Yearly check `astral_planes.10`: over a year into mid-game and at least one country has completed 5 rift explorations; among countries with the Rift Sphere technology and ≥3 completed explorations the one with the most is chosen (a per-country random roll, halved for Riftworld and doubled for AI), and a Crystal Sphere is placed in its system closest to the capital that has no natural wormhole (nomads: the system of an owned waystation). Global flag `crystal_sphere_sent` makes it happen only once. `astral_planes.15` fires 10 days plus up to 350 days later.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 水晶球体（15）：球体出现在轨道上，可能危险也可能蕴含维度旅行的线索。选择研究（→ 情境“研究水晶球体”）或摧毁（→ 情境“摧毁水晶球体”）。
2. 两个情境各有 100 进度的一个阶段，需要科技“裂隙探球”才有进度（否则乘数为 0）；方法可选（观察 / 常规研究 / 星界丝缕法；机械搅动 / 星界法）。
3. 研究完成 → `astral_situation.5` “研究结束”：球体消失，原地生成晶体裂隙（见《晶体裂隙》）。摧毁完成 → `astral_situation.1`：球体被打碎。
4. 若水晶球所在星系易手：旧主人得 `20`（标记 `has_lost_crystal_sphere`，情境中止），新主人得 `25`：有裂隙探球则直接 15，否则 `30` “奇怪的球体”，之后研究出探球时 `35` 再触发 15。

1. The Crystal Sphere (15): a sphere arrives in orbit, possibly dangerous, possibly a key to dimensional travel. Choose to study it (→ situation “Study the Crystal Sphere”) or destroy it (→ situation “Destroy the Crystal Sphere”).
2. Each situation has one 100-progress stage and makes no progress without the Rift Sphere technology; the method is selectable (observe / mundane / astral-thread method; mechanical agitation / astral method).
3. Study complete → `astral_situation.5` “The Study Is Over”: the sphere vanishes and the Crystal Rift appears (see “The Crystal Rift”). Destroy complete → `astral_situation.1`: the sphere is shattered.
4. If the sphere's system changes hands, the old owner gets `20` (flag `has_lost_crystal_sphere`, the situation aborts) and the new owner `25`: with the Rift Sphere technology 15 at once, else `30` “A Strange Sphere”, and `35` fires 15 once the technology is researched.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 研究：生成晶体裂隙，可继续探索（能打开通往“形态之物”的虫洞，或封印它）。
- 摧毁：100 星界丝缕、500 稀有水晶、500 奇异气体、修正 `destroy_sphere_modifier`（3600 天）、标本“水晶球体碎片”；排外或狂暴灭绝者另得凝聚力。

- Study: the Crystal Rift appears and can be explored (it can open a wormhole to the Formless, or seal it).
- Destroy: 100 astral threads, 500 rare crystals, 500 exotic gases, modifier `destroy_sphere_modifier` (3600 days), the specimen “crystal sphere fragments”; xenophobes and homicidal empires also get unity.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 15 的正文有三种：初始、通过 25 取得、延迟取得；AI 偏好：唯灵者与裂隙世界起源倾向研究，排外 / 狂暴灭绝者倾向摧毁。
- 裂隙世界起源与 AI 的随机骰有修正，影响谁得到球体。

- Three texts for 15: initial, acquired via 25, acquired late; AI preference: spiritualists and Riftworld lean to study, xenophobes and homicidal empires lean to destroy.
- Riftworld and AI modify the random roll deciding who receives the sphere.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：10/15/20/25/30/35，两个情境，`astral_situation.1/5`，相关 `on_actions`。更正：三个触发器被当作独立故事（10、25、35）；已合并，并补桥接 30 → 15 与 5 → 晶体裂隙。
- 不确定：随机骰的比较式按字面转述（`astral_planes.10:792–802`）。

- Checked: 10/15/20/25/30/35, both situations, `astral_situation.1/5` and the related `on_actions`. Correction: three trigger events (10, 25, 35) were separate stories; merged, with bridges 30 → 15 and 5 → the Crystal Rift.
- Uncertain: the roll comparison is paraphrased literally (`astral_planes.10:792–802`).
